subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should native WebChat URL parity be required in the same deliverable as the complete Control UI implementation?
rationale: The issue spans independent Lit and SwiftUI renderers, while its native scope is explicitly qualified as “if applicable,” so automation should not choose the resolution boundary.

options.title: Ship Both Surfaces
options.body: Require safe clickable URLs throughout Control UI and native WebChat before resolving the issue.

options.title: Control UI First
options.body: Complete every current Control UI tool-result path and track native WebChat parity in a separate issue.

recommendation.title: Ship Both Surfaces
recommendation.body: Require safe clickable URLs throughout Control UI and native WebChat before resolving the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest review explicitly framed this cross-surface acceptance question and examined both renderer families.
